newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sugar balance sheets to be discussed..
newsitem.headline: EU sugar balance sheets to be discussed..

text.p: The European Union's sugar management committee will discuss the sector's final sugar balance sheet on Wednesday, an EU official said on Tuesday.
"The committee will discuss the final balance sheet drawn up by the European Commission for beet sugar for the 1995/96 marketing year," the official said.
Last week the Commission refused to release details of the most recent estimate presented to the management committee saying that it contained inconsistencies.
"The estimate contained inconsistencies and over estimations and needed to be recalculated," an official said.
The provisional sugar supply balance sheet for 1996/97 will also be disccussed.
"The committee will discuss the provisional supply situation for 1996/97 together with the latest estimate of carry over supplies for 1997/98," the official said.
The final molasses balance sheet for 1995/96 will also be on the agenda and the committee will go on to discuss the final raw sugar balance sheet for 1996/97.
